svg.title: NoteFlow page flow
svg.desc: Flowchart of NoteFlow's page navigation grouped by function: entry (Landing, Sign Up, Log In), the Dashboard hub, the content-authoring pipeline (Modules through Questions), and assessment/retention (Quiz, Review), with a dashed loop feeding Quiz results back into the Dashboard's recommendations and Review's due queue.
svg.text: ENTRY · HUB · CONTENT · ASSESS/RETAIN — SOLID = NAV, DOTTED = ADAPTIVE LOOP
